faq.q: What does the Level 3 — Mould Remediation course cover?
faq.a: Designed for large-scale contamination over ten square metres involving structural materials, HVAC systems, and high-risk environments like hospitals, schools, and aged care facilities.

courseJsonLd.name: Level 3 — Mould Remediation
courseJsonLd.description: Designed for large-scale contamination over ten square metres involving structural materials, HVAC systems, and high-risk environments like hospitals, schools, and aged care facilities. You learn advanced risk assessment, full-scale containment design with negative pressure monitoring, respirator fit-testing obligations, heat management planning for extended PPE use, psychrometric analysis for drying, moisture mapping across large sites, how different building materials affect remediation decisions, and how to lead a complex project to close-out — potentially alongside an independent industrial hygienist for air clearance testing.
